test_transform_ufunc: test applying a numpy ufunc like np.sqrt as a transform on a DataFrame or Series with a given axis
test_transform_listlike: test applying a list of numpy operations like [np.sqrt, np.abs] as transforms returning a MultiIndex column result
test_transform_dictlike: test applying a column-to-function mapping dict like {col: np.abs} to transform specific DataFrame columns
test_transform_udf_with_args: test passing user-defined functions with positional and keyword arguments to DataFrame.transform
test_transform_empty_input: test that transforming with empty list or dict raises ValueError with 'No transform functions were provided'
